Outline two differences between an array and an ArrayList.
questions.model: Array: fixed size, primitives or objects, length field. ArrayList: dynamic size, objects only (wrappers like Integer), size() method; you specify the element type in angle brackets.

questions.q: Explain autoboxing with an example.
questions.model: Automatic conversion of a primitive to its wrapper object: Integer y = 10; or list.add(5) on an ArrayList<Integer>. Unboxing is the reverse: int z = y;

questions.q: Using StringTokenizer, count the words in "Java is fun to learn" and print each on its own line.
Explain throw vs throws, and checked vs unchecked exceptions, with one example of each exception type.
questions.model: throw triggers an exception in a body; throws declares that a method may pass a checked exception on. Checked (IOException) are verified at compile time and must be handled or declared; unchecked (ArithmeticException, a RuntimeException) occur at run time and handling is optional.
